description: This file defines the NonBufferedBody class implementing the PSR-7 StreamInterface, representing a non-buffered HTTP body stream used in the Slim framework.

classes.name: NonBufferedBody
classes.description: A class implementing StreamInterface representing a non-buffered, write-only HTTP body stream that does not support buffering, seeking, or reading.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns an empty string since the body is non-buffered.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Throws RuntimeException since a NonBufferedBody cannot be closed.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Returns null, indicating detach is unsupported.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns null, body size is unknown.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Always returns 0, position indicator is not meaningful.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Returns true, indicating end-of-file is always reached.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Returns false, the stream does not support seeking.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Throws RuntimeException; seeking is not supported.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Throws RuntimeException; rewind is not supported.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Returns true, the stream supports writing.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Outputs the given string to the output buffer, flushes, and returns the total length written.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Returns false; reading is not supported.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Throws RuntimeException; reading is not supported.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns an empty string; no contents to read.
